events.verdict: Mitchell (CLE) maintains his hand on the side of the ball during his spin move and does not bring his left hand to it as he continues his legal dribble.
Bridges (BKN) moves alongside of Mitchell (CLE) and marginal hip contact occurs during his drive to the basket.
O'Neale (BKN) establishes himself in Okoro's (CLE) path and absorbs the contact from Okoro's chest as he defends underneath the pick.
Strus (CLE) places a collapsing forearm to Thomas' (BKN) front and marginal contact occurs during his drive to the basket.
Strus (CLE) jumps towards Thomas (BKN) and lowers his arm, initiating contact with Thomas' arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Claxton (BKN) briefly places his hands on Strus' (CLE) front off-ball before retracting and separating.
Strus (CLE) attempts to slip by Bridges (BKN) and marginal body contact occurs as they come together.
As Mobley (CLE) attempts to release from his screening position, his arm comes out slightly toward Claxton (BKN), causing marginal contact to occur.
Okoro (CLE) moves into Bridges' (BKN) back with a forearm, which displaces Bridges and knocks him out of his rebounding position.
O'Neale (BKN) places resting hands against Stus (CLE) as he moves toward the ball and immediately slides his hands off.
Mobley (CLE) turns to roll and incidental contact occurs with O'Neale (BKN) as O'Neale defends underneath the pick.
Mitchell (CLE) slides his hand off and releases from Claxton (BKN) during his step-back at the end of his drive.
Mobley (CLE) fails to fully clear the lane and is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Strus (CLE) cleanly dislodges Johnson's (BKN) jump shot attempt and prior incidental any contact occurring.
Finney-Smith (BKN) initiates contact with Strus' (CLE) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
As O'Neale (BKN) attempts to hand off the ball, Mitchell (CLE) extends his arm toward the ball and cleanly dislodges it prior to incidental contact occurring.
Bridges (BKN) leans into Mitchell (CLE) off-ball and marginal contact occurs as Bridges moves toward the sideline.
Johnson (BKN) pins the ball two his hip on his right foot and takes two legal steps.
Mitchell (CLE) moves toward Bridges (BKN) on the perimeter, causing both players to come together before separating.
As Bridges (BKN) and Mitchell (CLE) are moving in the same direction, Bridges briefly grasps Mitchell's arms before both players separate, and the contact is marginal.
Finney-Smith (BKN) is firming up over his right foot in Strus' (CLE) path and absorbs the body contact before both players briefly engage and separate following the pick.
Johnson (BKN) gathers the ball by pinning it against his body on his right foot, establishing his left foot as his pivot, which he maintains before passing.
Mitchell (CLE) makes clean contact with the ball to initially dislodge the oncoming pass to Bridges (BKN).
Finney-Smith (BKN) is imminently exiting the lane within three seconds.
Mitchell (CLE) dives for the loose ball and delivers contact to Bridges' (BKN) lower body, affecting his ability to gather the ball and subsequently dislodging him.
Johnson (BKN) steps toward Mitchell's (CLE) path, causing the two to come together and marginal contact to occur.
Bridges (BKN) briefly grasps LeVert's (CLE) arm as both players are engaging off-ball before separating and moving around the screen.
Thomas (BKN) slightly extends his leg as he releases his jump shot attempt, and marginal lower-body contact occurs as Mobley (CLE) legally closes out to his side.
Mitchell (CLE) reaches toward the ball, causing marginal lower-body contact to occur with Johnson (BKN), who is jumping away from the contact and toward the baseline during his put-back shot attempt.
